messages.subject: New MaxQuant output and MSstatsTMT
parts:
Hello,
I was wondering if MSstatsTMT is OK to use with the new version of the MaxQuant output. Changes in the calculations of the TMT channel intensities are described in their recent paper (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32892627/).
Basically, now reporter ion intensities in the evidence.txt table are either:
1) ratios to reference channel (Ref=1, Ch2=1.2, Ch3=0.8, etc) 
or
2) normalized so the sum across all the channels in 1
I was wondering if this could cause any problems. The scripts are working just fine but I want to double check if this is OK. 
Thanks in advance)
